dedupe_keys.name: national earth system science data center geophysics sub centre 地球物理科学数据中心 geospace geodata cn

description: The Geophysics sub-centre of China's National Earth System Science Data Center publishes geophysical and space environment datasets, with thematic databases IONISE and MIOS and a Madrigal mirror. It is run with the Chinese Academy of Sciences space environment observation network at the Institute of Geology and Geophysics in Beijing, and, as the Beijing station's page explains, it is where the Beijing Space Environment National Field Station releases processed ionosonde, GNSS, magnetometer and meteor radar data (58 datasets published in 2019). The related China Geophysics Data Center is a member of the ICSU World Data System and an AGU-recognised repository. Coverage is China through stations such as Beijing Shisanling, Wuhan Zuoling and Sanya. Format and access: a Chinese and English portal with search by subject, keyword and location and an ordering system for registered users. Licence: not stated on the pages read; free. Caveats: the English interface and metadata depth vary, and the About page could not be opened. It supports hazard exposure studies of ionospheric and geomagnetic storms for GNSS and power grids. Related catalogue records are the Chinese Meridian Project data centre and INTERMAGNET, to which the Beijing station also sends minute data.
